title: Flipkart plans to launch ‘Earth’ to tap demand for premium, sustainable products
summary: Flipkart plans to launch Earth brand for premium and sustainable products
detailed: The company has started onboarding brands offering healthier, toxin-free, and sustainable products across beauty and personal care (BPC), snacks and beverages, home decor, fashion, appliances, and other categories, people familiar with the development told ET.
